# macOS

## Install

### Homebrew

```
/bin/bash -c "$(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Homebrew/install/HEAD/install.sh)"
```

### Podman

```
brew install podman
podman machine init
podman machine start
sudo /opt/homebrew/Cellar/podman/4.4.2/bin/podman-mac-helper install
```
